failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Answer repeats words the clue already states or a type noun: 'Conan the Destroyer' for 'Conan', 'radical sign' for 'radical' (clue says 'symbol'), and 'Chinese Hand Laundry Alliance' for 'laundries' (clue says 'alliance of these Chinese businesses'). The DELETE-CLUE-WORDS and slot rules were not applied.

rejected_edits.content: - READ-BACK TEST (run on your final candidate): substitute it for 'this <noun>' / 'he' / 'she' / 'these' and read the clue as a sentence. It must be true and not circular. (a) 'This author / inventor / ruler / founder', or 'he/she' + an action ('sued...', 'founded...') -> the PERSON. An effect, law, theory, title, case, issue or object named after or tied to that person fails. (b) PART vs WHOLE: in 'a building / wing / gallery at this site / museum / campus is named for X', the named part is an anchor and the answer is the WHOLE place. (c) 'The alliance / union / guild of these <businesses/workers>' -> the plural noun for the MEMBERS, not the organization's own name.
rejected_edits.target: Ask: what category is the answer (country, person, vitamin, object, band), and what member of that category fits all the clue details?

rejected_edits.content: Likewise keep the head noun when the clue supplies only it ('the type of irrigation used in Israel' -> 'drip irrigation', not 'drip'), or when the clue quotes it right after 'this' (this "bubble") and the passages' standard name includes it. Strip clue words only when what remains is itself a complete, accepted name; the DELETE-CLUE-WORDS test is for separate descriptor words, not for a head word that is part of the proper name.
rejected_edits.target: The 'do not repeat clue words' rule is for a separate modifier already stated in the clue ('hasty' + pudding).
